title: Paying an invoice that moved to another payer is refused
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C, the new payer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced for $210.00, billed to customer B, unpaid.
  • Open customer B's Invoices tab in a first browser tab and work order 1 in a second tab.
custom_steps:
1. In the first tab, tick work order 1's invoice.
  2. Click New Payment.
  3. Switch to the second tab.
  4. Open the Finance tab.
  5. Reverse the invoice.
  6. Expand the Customer card.
  7. Click the Bill To field.
  8. Pick customer C in the list.
  9. Click Create Invoice on the Finance tab.
  10. Switch to the first tab.
  11. Click Make Payment.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The invoice is ticked.

Step 2:

  • The New Customer Payment window shows the invoice for $210.00.

Step 3:

  • The second tab shows work order 1 for customer A.

Step 4:

  • The Finance tab lists the invoice.

Step 5:

  • The invoice is removed and work order 1 is back to Complete.

Step 6:

  • "Bill To" reads customer B's name.

Step 7:

  • The list opens.

Step 8:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer C's name.

Step 9:

  • The invoice is created again for customer C.

Step 10:

  • The payment window is still open.

Step 11:

  • The payment is refused with "This payment can only be applied to invoices billed to [customer B's name]." as the app's standard error toast, captioned "Please try to resolve this."
  • The toast fades after 3 seconds.
  • No payment is recorded: customer B's Payments tab shows no new payment.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as customer B's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12312 (Story 10, Receivables follow the Bill To)

  • S10-R5: “The server refuses a payment applied to another customer's invoice with M3.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “M3 | Payment applied to another customer's invoice | "This payment can only be applied to invoices billed to [customer]." | Standard error toast”
  • Story 10, Error Handling: “M3 and M5 show as an error toast and no payment is recorded.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Server refusals without a button show as the app's standard error toast, captioned "Please try to resolve this.", and fade after 3 seconds.”
  • Key Decisions: “A payment settles only invoices its own customer owes. Enforced for new payments only; existing applications are left as they are.”
  • Feature Overview, State by action (Action | Open | Invoiced | Internal or No Charge): “Take a payment | n/a | From the Bill To's account only (M3) | n/a”
